text: A General Recipe for Designing Heuristics Goal: Estimate how far a state is from a solution. Step-by-Step Recipe © Start with the original problem o Full constraints o Real cost function @ Relax one or more constraints o Allow illegal moves o Merge distinctions between states © Solve the relaxed problem o Often easier: BFS, counting, geometry Q Use the solution cost as h(n) o Cost of relaxed problem < true cost
